items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: I didn’t like Bob Dylan for that reason. I hated his singing, and it took me years to get over that and to appreciate what he was about.

ctx.x: So the general question is how do you do that? How do you memorize those things?

Well you know off of the melody for sure. People will say a song title to me and I’ll go, “Oh I’m not sure” and I’ll say, “sing it.” And once they start singing the melody I connect. Now that doesn’t hook you up for the bridge necessarily you know. The old timers would tell me, “Learn the lyrics” which I never did. I wasn’t good at learning lyrics. But if you learn the lyrics you would never forget the bridge. And they had great little tips to help younger guys out. But I never listened to lyrics. So I missed – I…
other thing that the old timers used to do, ballads, you know knowing the lyrics of the song, they really get inside of it you know and, you know, emotion would flow out of them you know.
